title_zh: 把天气活动说明从必然下雨改为可能下雨

scenario.label_zh: 区分天气概率与确定结果
scenario.goal_zh: 依据课堂给定预报修订必然下雨的说法，并保留室内备用活动说明

context_zh: 学生依据题目提供的虚构预报准备活动公告。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: The exercise gives an eighty percent probability of rain. I've written that rain is certain.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.text: That's too strong. It makes rain probable, not guaranteed.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Could I say that rain is likely and mention our indoor backup?

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.text: Yes. The forecast doesn't tell us exactly when or how much it will rain either.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Then I'll remove the sentence saying it will pour at noon.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.text: Good. Keep the backup-room details so people know what to do if the outdoor session moves.
